author: Kusha N M
raw:
ದೀನತೆಯ ಹೊಂದದಿರು ಮೇಲರಿಮೆ ತೋರದಿರು
ಮಾನಾಪಮಾನಗಳ ಸಮನಾಗಿ ನೋಡು
ನೀನೆಂದು ನಿಜದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಮಚಿತ್ತನಾಗುವೆಯೊ
ಹೀನತೆಯ ತೊಡೆಯುವೆಯೊ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Do not sink into self-pity, nor show superiority;
look on honour and dishonour alike;
when will you truly become even-minded?
when will you wipe away your meanness, O deluded one?
en.bhavartha: Avoid both self-pity and arrogance, and meet praise and insult with the same calm. That evenness of mind is what frees us from pettiness.
